Tarot composition: Nine of Wands. Carver rests one hand on ONE upright wooden wand and stands resiliently before exactly EIGHT wooden wands planted in a clear row behind him. NINE total, all nine tops individually visible, not overlapped or cut off. Purple mohawk and muscular physique with blue-gray vest/orange sash remain faithful. Slightly tired but confident face, healed small cloth wrist wrap only, no injury or fighting. Endurance at sunset.
One coherent illustration, no collage. Absolutely no card title, text, numbers, letters, UI, logo, watermark, outer border/frame or photographed card. Do not add extra weapons or suit objects. Objects explicitly counted must all be visibly separate and accurately counted, with no duplicates or obscured extras. Preserve official costume and clear anatomy.
